name: Hard Rock Hotel Singapore
description: The most rock and roll hotel at Resorts World Sentosa — Hard Rock Hotel is a vibrant 5-star resort celebrating music culture with memorabilia-lined corridors, a spectacular rock-themed pool, multiple restaurants and direct walkway access to Universal Studios Singapore. The most popular hotel for younger visitors and music fans.

rooms.name: Standard Room
rooms.description: Rock-themed room with music memorabilia, free WiFi and en-suite bathroom with direct USS access.

rooms.name: Deluxe Room
rooms.description: Spacious deluxe room with upgraded rock theming, pool or resort views and premium amenities.

rooms.name: Rock Suite
rooms.description: Spectacular rock-themed suite with separate living area, exclusive memorabilia and butler service.

name: Equarius Hotel
description: The most luxurious hotel at Resorts World Sentosa — Equarius Hotel is a serene 5-star retreat nestled within lush tropical rainforest gardens on Sentosa Island. Features extraordinary Forest Villa rooms with private pools, a magnificent spa, Michelin-starred dining and the most tranquil atmosphere of any hotel in Singapore.

rooms.name: Deluxe Room
rooms.description: Elegant room with forest or resort views, free WiFi and marble bathroom.

rooms.name: Forest Villa
rooms.description: Extraordinary villa with private pool nestled in tropical rainforest — the ultimate Singapore luxury.

rooms.name: Junior Suite
rooms.description: Spacious suite with forest views, separate living area and complimentary breakfast.

name: Hotel Michael
description: A stylish art-inspired 5-star hotel at Resorts World Sentosa celebrating the work of Michael Graves — one of America most celebrated architects. Features bold geometric design, curated contemporary art throughout and comfortable rooms with direct access to the Resorts World Sentosa entertainment complex.

rooms.name: Standard Room
rooms.description: Artfully designed room with free WiFi, flat-screen TV and en-suite bathroom.

rooms.name: Deluxe Room
rooms.description: Larger deluxe room with upgraded furnishings, pool or sea views.

rooms.name: Junior Suite
rooms.description: Spacious suite with separate living area and complimentary breakfast.

name: The Outpost Hotel Sentosa
description: A fun and affordable boutique hotel on Sentosa Island, 10 minutes walk from Universal Studios Singapore — featuring colourful rooms, a rooftop pool with sea views and easy access to all Sentosa Island attractions. The best value accommodation option close to Universal Studios Singapore.

rooms.name: Standard Room
rooms.description: Colourful modern room with free WiFi, flat-screen TV and en-suite bathroom.

rooms.name: Superior Room
rooms.description: Larger superior room with upgraded furnishings and pool or sea views.

rooms.name: Deluxe Room
rooms.description: Spacious deluxe room with rooftop pool access and premium amenities.
